title: Ultimate Malty Russian Potato Dumplings
description: A traditional Russian dish featuring malty, fluffy potato dumplings with peppercorns, perfect for a midnight craving, and sugar-free-friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated potatoes, malt flour, black peppercorns, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and melted butter.
Add the egg mixture to the potato mixture and stir until just combined.
Fold in chopped onion and all-purpose flour.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium heat and fry the dumplings for 3-4 minutes on each side.
Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite toppings.
